import_origin.detail: Every GPU run used .deps/isaacsim-venv/bin/python with PYTHONPATH=src (chain scripts) and run_baseline.py inserts <worktree>/src at sys.path[0] before importing robotic_cutting_sim. The Isaac Sim venv has no robotic_cutting_sim installed, and the main checkout has no robotic_cutting_sim.rl subpackage, so the rl.replay relative imports (live_material, tlmpm_v7_2, goals) can only resolve to this worktree; verified by printing the module files. Manifest source_sha256 records the worktree sources; runs after this note also record package_origin.
